summary: Santander UK Group Holdings PLC, via a Form 6-K, announced the completion of its cash acquisition of TSB Banking Group plc from Banco de Sabadell. The total consideration paid at closing was approximately €2.65 billion plus an estimated €213 million for tangible net asset value variation, financed from Santander UK's cash resources and parent funding. The deal received regulatory approvals from the PRA and ECB. Integration of TSB into Santander UK is planned via a Part VII transfer in H1 2027, subject to court and regulatory clearances. The acquisition makes Santander UK the third-largest UK bank by current account balances and aims for a 16% RoTE by 2028. Watch for completion of the TNAV adjustment and integration milestones.
